Create a short event notice in macOS TextEdit using the desktop controls.

1. Open TextEdit and create a rich-text document with the following content, in this
   order. Optional blank lines between sections are welcome. Use the exact wording;
   place each agenda item on its own bulleted line. TextEdit's bullet list or typed
   bullet characters (•) are both acceptable.

   Community Design Meetup
   Date: 12 November 2026
   Time: 14:00-15:30
   Location: Harbour Studio, Room 2
   Agenda
   • Welcome and introductions
   • Poster design demo
   • Questions and next steps
   Contact: Maya Chen | hello@example.org

2. Format the title in 24-point bold type, centered. Set every other line to 12-point
   type and left alignment. Choose any readable font. Keep the notice free of
   additional text or images.

3. Apply the schedule update: change the time line to `Time: 15:30-17:00`.
   Keep all other content unchanged.

4. Save the rich-text document as `/Users/admin/output/notice.rtf`. Close its window,
   reopen the saved file in TextEdit, and check that the updated time and formatting
   are preserved. Finish with the saved notice open in TextEdit and report its path.

Use screenshots and desktop mouse/keyboard controls to create, edit, format, save,
and reopen the document. Use the application's menus, Dock, Spotlight, or Finder
to launch it and navigate. Shell commands, AppleScript/JXA, programmatic file writes,
and pasted executable code must not be used to produce or manipulate the document.
No extra report or screenshot files are required. Work independently.
